messages.subject: G2 Statistic
parts:
Dear Phil,
thank you again for your good advice.
Am I right in assuming that the G2 (the likelihood-ratio test statistic) for the Graded Response Model compares the Restricted and the Saturated Model?

scores <- fscores(mod, method = 'EAPsum')
attr(scores, 'fit')

Best regards I.B

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: G2 Statistic
parts:
Not quite, these are the typical 'goodness of fit' statistics based off of the total scores. So the usual assumptions for Chi-squared and G2 statistics are required (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pearson%27s_chi-squared_test), and may require manually collapsing cells if the expected values are too low. Cheers.

Phil
